boundary: Organisation or location obligations only — excludes per-asset, per-vehicle, and per-person owned schedules (LOLER/PAT/PSSR per item, training, drivers).

templates.title: Fire Risk Assessment
templates.description: Annual FRA review for each premises; new FRA on significant change.

templates.title: FRA Site Visit
templates.description: Internal or external assessor visit feeding the FRA.

templates.title: Fire Inspections & Testing
templates.description: Premises fire system and equipment servicing programme (alarms, extinguishers, emergency lighting).

templates.title: Fire Drill & Evacuation
templates.description: At least annual fire drill and evacuation plan review per premises.

templates.title: Fixed Electrical Inspection (EICR)
templates.description: Fixed-wire EICR for premises (typically five-yearly).

templates.title: EV & Charging Infrastructure Inspection
templates.description: Inspection and maintenance of site EV charge points.

templates.title: LEV Thorough Examination & Test
templates.description: Thorough examination and test of local exhaust ventilation systems.

templates.title: Gas Safety Inspection
templates.description: Annual Gas Safe inspection of premises heating and appliances.

templates.title: Asbestos Re-inspection
templates.description: Annual re-inspection of asbestos register / management plan for pre-2000 buildings.

templates.title: Legionella Risk Assessment
templates.description: Legionella risk assessment (typically two-yearly) with ongoing monitoring programme.

templates.title: Insurance Renewal
templates.description: Annual renewal of EL/PL and related insurance certificates.

templates.title: Licences & Permits Renewal
templates.description: Renewal tracking for waste carrier, F-Gas, trade accreditations and similar permits.

templates.title: Buildings & Premises Compliance Review
templates.description: Periodic premises condition and lease-compliance review.

templates.title: DSEAR Assessment
templates.regulatory_basis: Dangerous Substances and Explosive Atmospheres Regulations 2002
templates.description: DSEAR risk assessment review for workshop / stores processes.

templates.title: First Aid & Welfare Review
templates.description: Annual review of first-aid provision and welfare arrangements.

templates.title: First-aider Coverage (n of m)
templates.description: Site duty to maintain the appointed first-aider quorum (n of m). Named first aiders stay on the Atlas competence board; this row is the location obligation, not a per-person training record.

templates.title: Fire Marshal Coverage (n of m)
templates.description: Site duty to maintain the appointed fire-marshal quorum (n of m) for evacuation. Named marshals stay on the Atlas competence board; this row is the location obligation, not a per-person training record.

templates.title: Mental Health First Aider Coverage (n of m)
templates.regulatory_basis: Internal wellbeing policy / HSE stress management standards
templates.description: Site duty to maintain the appointed mental-health first-aider quorum (n of m). Named MHFAs stay on the Atlas competence board; this row is the location obligation, not a per-person training record.

templates.title: Business Continuity Plan Test
templates.description: Annual BCP / emergency plan test.

templates.title: Policy Review Cycle
templates.description: Annual review of company policy suite.

templates.title: Management Review
templates.description: Annual ISO management review meeting and record.

templates.title: Internal Audit Programme
templates.description: Annual internal audit programme completion.

templates.title: Carbon / Planet Mark Reporting
templates.description: Annual carbon reporting cycle.

templates.title: Environmental Aspects & Spill Response Review
templates.description: Annual environmental aspects register and spill-response readiness review.

templates.title: UK GDPR Annual Review
templates.description: Annual data-protection compliance review.

templates.title: Information Security Annual Review
templates.description: Annual information security / ISMS review.

templates.title: Approved Supplier Register Review
templates.description: Annual approved-supplier register review.

templates.title: Toolbox Talk Programme
templates.description: Monthly toolbox-talk programme cadence (org/location programme, not per-person training records).
